tokens.name: surface-lowest
tokens.usage: Deepest ground: the Bookmap stage and full-bleed chart canvases. Was the Bookmap's own #08090c. In Light the warm-paper ground #efede7, the lightest step of the ramp, which heat-0 matches; was #ffffff.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App background and the canvas ground of time-aligned panes. Was --bg; also the PWA theme colour. Light was #f8f9fc before the warm-paper ramp.

tokens.name: surface-low
tokens.usage: Level 1 tonal surface: toolbars over a chart (Bookmap controls, readout strip), the view-tab bar. Replaces the Bookmap's #0c0e12. Light was #f2f4f8 before the warm-paper ramp.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Level 2 tonal surface: panels, status bar, instrument strip, sticky table headers. Was --panel. Light was #eceff4 before the warm-paper ramp.

tokens.name: surface-high
tokens.usage: Level 3 tonal surface: resting controls, list rows, an active table row, text-field fill. Was --panel-2. Light was #e6eaf0 before the warm-paper ramp.

tokens.name: surface-highest
tokens.usage: Level 4 tonal surface: menus, a solid tooltip, chart grid lines. Was the canvas grid colour. The darkest Light surface, so the Light contrast floors bind on it. Light was #dde3eb before the warm-paper ramp.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between panels and table sections; decorative only (below 3:1 on purpose). Was --border. Light was #cdd4de, warmed and darkened with the surfaces so a divider keeps 1.17:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: text-field and outlined-button borders, the spread rule. 3:1 or better on every surface up to surface-highest (3.14:1 at worst in Terminal, 3.00:1 in Light). Light was #737d8f, darkened only as far as its floor on the warm-paper ground needs.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings, the ladder's price column and selected labels, on every surface (11:1 or better). Was --text-strong.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Body copy and numbers on every surface (10:1 or better in Terminal, 7.8:1 in Light). Was --text.

tokens.name: on-surface-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, column heads, legends and secondary values on every surface (5.2:1 on surface-highest in Terminal, 4.5:1 in Light). Replaces --muted #7d889b, which fell to 4.4:1 on surface-highest; the same value as the canvas axis colour. Light was #555f70, darkened only as far as its floor on the warm-paper ground needs.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The accent: focus rings, hover borders, the selected tab's indicator, the Range regime, filled buttons. As text 5.8:1 or better on every surface in Terminal, 4.5:1 in Light. Was --accent. Light was #1d5bbf, darkened only as far as its floor on the warm-paper ground needs.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (5.8:1).

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Tonal fill for a selected or pressed control: a pressed toggle, the chosen product row. Was the pressed-button #213454.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text on primary-container (9.7:1). Muted text never goes on this fill.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: State layer laid over a control on hover (8%).

tokens.name: state-pressed
tokens.usage: State layer while pressed or focused (12%).

tokens.name: state-dragged
tokens.usage: State layer while a chart or ladder is dragged (16%).

tokens.name: scrim-chart

tokens.name: scrim-tooltip

tokens.name: up
tokens.usage: Price up, a blue: rising candles, positive change and CVD, Trend ↑, buy volume (through aggressor-buy), bullish signals, agreeing timeframes, a positive histogram bar. 4.9:1 or better as text on every surface in Terminal, 4.5:1 in Light; ΔE 48 from bid in Terminal and 53 in Light, so it stays apart from the book's blue. Always paired with ↑, ▲ or a + sign: up and down differ mostly by hue (1.5:1 between them in Terminal, 1.0:1 in Light). Was the teal #26a69a / #00695c (D-48). Light was #2f45e0, darkened only as far as its floor on the warm-paper ground needs. The theme default of a chart colour role: a viewer may choose its own colour per theme, kept in this browser, and it then means the same on every tab (D-51).

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: Price down, a neutral grey (light in Terminal, mid in Light so it holds 4.6:1 on every Light surface): falling candles, negative change and CVD, Trend ↓, sell volume (through aggressor-sell), bearish signals, a negative histogram bar. Always paired with ↓, ▼ or a − sign. Never a warning: that is danger. Was the red #ef5350 / #b71c1c (D-48). Light was #5f5f5f, darkened to hold 4.5:1 on surface-highest and on the split footprint cells of the warm-paper ground. The theme default of a chart colour role: a viewer may choose its own colour per theme, kept in this browser, and it then means the same on every tab (D-51).

tokens.name: danger

tokens.name: warmup
tokens.usage: Warmup history with no aggressor side: candles, the close line and CVD before the live watermark, its edge and band, and warmup and unsided volume. Never up or down. A stroked line, so 3:1 or better on every surface (3.10:1 at worst in Terminal, 3.01:1 in Light, both on surface-highest); a mid grey between down and the ground, dashed where it continues the price line. Was #5c6370 / #8a919d, 2.6:1 and 2.5:1 at worst. Light was #7a8089 from until darkened it for the warm-paper ground. The band is this token at 0.25 alpha over surface-lowest, and the marks on it hold 3:1 there too (3.10:1 in Terminal, 3.07:1 in Light); it was 0.28, 2.99:1 and 2.95:1. The theme default of a chart colour role: a viewer may choose its own colour per theme, kept in this browser, and it then means the same on every tab (D-51).

tokens.name: dot-label
tokens.usage: Quantity printed on a large volume dot (18px or larger, bold), stroked first in dot-label-halo. A total of 1,000 or more is five glyphs, 30px, wider than the dot, so every glyph sits on the halo: 17:1 or better against it in both themes. Where the glyphs fall inside the dot it also holds 4.5:1 on each segment: in Terminal a dark label, 6.1:1 on aggressor-buy and 9.2:1 on aggressor-sell; in Light a light one, 6.6:1 and 6.9:1. Was #f5f7fb in both themes with no halo, which fell to 2.0:1 on the grey sell disc in Terminal and to 1.0:1 where a Light label ran onto the white stage. (2026-11-15, D-51: those are the theme defaults. When a viewer recolours up or down, the label takes whichever of dot-label and dot-label-halo reads better on both chosen slices, and the halo the other ink.)

tokens.name: dot-label-halo
tokens.usage: The halo stroked 3px wide under a volume dot's quantity, in the opposite ink to dot-label (the price-line pattern of D-40: a line over a halo): light in Terminal, dark in Light. 17:1 or better against dot-label in both themes, and against the stage the label overflows onto (surface-lowest, heat-0) 17:1 or better in Terminal and 16:1 in Light, since the warm-paper ground (18.7:1 on the old white). Inside the dot it is only a thin rim (1.9:1 to 2.9:1 on the segments), where the label also holds 4.5:1 on the dot itself. (2026-11-15, D-51: those are the theme defaults. When a viewer recolours up or down so that the label swaps ink, the halo takes the label's default ink.)

tokens.name: dot-outline-buy
tokens.usage: The edge of a volume dot's buy-aggressor share, on Detail and Order Flow alike: the whole edge of an all-buy dot, and on a split dot only the arc of its buy slice (from 12 o'clock clockwise). Stroked 1.5px over the fill and under the quantity, outside a 1px dot-outline-halo. A green, so it reads as buying beside the blue fill: a line, 3:1 or better on the six surfaces, heat-0 and the Order Flow warmup band (9.52:1 at worst in Terminal, 4.64:1 in Light, both on surface-highest), 11.9:1 and 6.9:1 against its halo. ΔE 44 or more from bid, ask, up, down and every event marker in Terminal, 17 in Light (event-unfinished-auction). The theme default of a chart colour role, held to the line floor (D-52).

tokens.name: dot-outline-sell
tokens.usage: The edge of a volume dot's sell-aggressor share, on Detail and Order Flow alike: the whole edge of an all-sell dot, and on a split dot the arc of its sell share. Stroked like dot-outline-buy. A red, so it reads as selling beside the grey fill: a line, 3:1 or better on the six surfaces, heat-0 and the Order Flow warmup band (6.38:1 at worst in Terminal, 5.02:1 in Light, both on surface-highest), 8.0:1 and 7.5:1 against its halo. Light enough in Terminal to hold 3.11:1 on the blue heat-25, where its dark halo holds only 2.57:1. ΔE 27 or more from bid, ask, up, down and every event marker in Terminal (ask), 12 in Light (ask). The theme default of a chart colour role, held to the line floor (D-52).

tokens.name: dot-outline-halo
tokens.usage: The thin halo, 1px, stroked just outside a volume dot's outline, so the outline still shows where a brighter heat cell matches it (the dot-label-halo pattern of D-48): the dot label's ink, dark in Terminal and light in Light. On the heat stops the outline or its halo holds 3:1 or better (Terminal: 4.64:1, 15.6:1, 8.5:1 and 4.0:1 on heat-25 to heat-100 for the buy outline; Light: 7.2:1, 5.8:1, 3.2:1 and 4.6:1), where the outline alone falls to 1.07:1 in Terminal and 1.03:1 in Light. Not chosen: when a viewer recolours either outline, the halo takes whichever of dot-label and dot-label-halo reads better on both chosen outlines (D-52).
